run_generate_demo: run the generate_demo script with --input_file, --tasks, and --data_file arguments to generate visual demos
run_generate_demo_vqa: run generate_demo with --tasks VQA to show image, question, and different answers
run_generate_demo_refcoco: run generate_demo with --tasks RefCOCO to show image, caption, and different bounding boxes
run_generate_demo_retrieval: run generate_demo with --tasks Retrieval to show caption and top 10 retrieved images
run_generate_demo_compare: run generate_demo with --compared_file to compare correct and wrong predictions
